Hi Elena/Raj — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the annotated terms. We appreciate the clarity.

After a brief cross-functional review, Redwood can accept the net-60 payment term for Medigenix on this private marketplace offer with the following minimal guardrails (summarized here and in the attached redline):

1) Payment Window: change Payment Terms to Net-60.
2) Grace Period: include a 30-day administrative grace period prior to applying late fees (Redwood prefers 30 vs. 45; we can split the difference if needed during CFO review).
3) Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue monthly invoices aligned to reserved capacity usage; the PO can remain annual and reference the monthly invoice schedule as an exhibit.
4) Initial invoice: for annual reserved capacity, Redwood requests the first invoice be settled within Net-45 for onboarding to reduce AR exposure; subsequent invoices can be Net-60. Alternatively, if Medigenix requires full Net-60 on the first invoice, Redwood requests a short-term credit hold/escrow (documented) until payment clears.

Attached: redline_az_offer_20270818.pdf (Redwood's amendment and redline against Medigenix's annotated terms). The redline highlights the Net-60 acceptance plus the two options for first-invoice handling.
